function.name: resolve_entity
function.description: Look up the real URI(s) for a name the user mentioned (species, city, botanical garden, ...) via full-text search over rdfs:label. Returns ranked candidates with their labels and match scores. Prefer this over guessing a URI. For species, pass the scientific (Latin) name, not a common name.

term.description: The name/label to look up, e.g. 'Achillea millefolium' or 'Jena'.

type.description: Optional class to narrow results, matched by the class' local name, e.g. 'dwc:Organism' or 'schema:City'.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of candidates to return (default 5).
